scope: Independent visual-only review of previously uninspected 9:00-to-end Super Saw chapter; no audio measurements or DSP changes.

primary_video.title: Roland SH-201 Patch Creation Part 2 (no talking)

official_mapping.p28: Super Saw is the right-middle WAVE indicator; final clockwise entry EXT IN lies below it.
official_mapping.p30: PW/FEEDBACK changes spread of seven component saws; DETUNE instead shifts all components together. No numeric endpoint spread supplied here.

acquisition.timing: First presented frame timestamp0; retained preceding keyframe packet timestamps begin -0.800800 with discard flag. Nominal source time=540+presentation time, not packet time. Observations rounded about0.5s; not sample-accurate audio synchronization.

inspection.dense_sampling: ffmpeg -i CLIP -vf fps=2 frame-%04d.png; crop contact sheets preserve actual pixels apart from ordinary resizing. Nominal grid labels approximate selected source frame within about0.5s.
inspection.selected_sampling: ffmpeg -ss (source_seconds-540) -i CLIP -frames:v 1 FRAME; full-resolution selected PNG names give nominal source seconds, seek rounded to available frame.

feasibility.conclusion: Useful for conditional spectral-line inspection and a spread-sweep demonstration. It does not provide an independently calibrated Super Saw detune endpoint or authenticated oscillator-only passage. An audio analyst must establish local stationarity, note/voice mixture and resolving power independently; visual interval endpoints are not measured note gates.

limitations: OSC labels/indicator icons are defocused; waveform mapping is positional, not invented text reading.
The selected oscillator index, mixer balance, other oscillator, LFO/pitch-envelope settings, part layer, exact note count, effects state and capture chain are not fully authenticated.
A visible knob face can differ from its stored parameter before manipulation; no raw reading or mechanical stop is certified.
Different waveform/OSC/FX gestures interrupt the chapter; no single full-chapter patch state assumed.
YouTube streams are platform transcodes, not the uncompressed source master.
